data.name: Old Ghost
data.description: An old Bingo Book entry, faded and worn, pinned to the mission board with a fresh brief. Old Ghost. Resurfaced after years in hiding. Once ran an ANBU cell in this village.
data.successDescription: Four squads have filed this report. The entry is still open.

objectives.description:
You wander into the missions hall, looking for your next job. A serious one this time, you decide.

Your eyes wander the board, sorting by rank. Then you see it.

An old bounty contract, faded and worn, pinned to the board with a fresh mission brief.

Old Ghost. Resurfaced after years in hiding.

Dangerous and resourceful fugitive from justice. Old Ghost once ran an ANBU cell in this village.

Current whereabouts unknown. Slums district is a good lead.

If he really is back, time matters. Someone like that moving freely inside the walls will not stay quiet for long.

You think about where to begin.
The wall walk runs the whole northern span. If he came in, he came over something.

Nothing. Fresh mortar, a bored sentry, and a long climb for no reason.

The sentry has been on this stretch eleven days and has seen nobody but the mortar crew.

You are looking in the wrong place.
The market is loud, crowded, and full of people who would notice a stranger. You work the stalls.

Plenty of rumours and none of them the same twice. A fugitive is worth talking about whether or not you have seen one.

By midday you have four descriptions of four different men, and the last one is you.

This is a waste of daylight.
The back alleys behind the cooperage are where you would go if you wanted to move unseen. So you follow them.

Somebody is moving ahead of you and moving fast, and you take three streets and a wall to run them down.

A courier. Fourteen years old, terrified, carrying somebody's laundry.

You send him on and lean against the wall.

Time you do not have.

You decide to search the Slums. Eastern side of the village, most of it fallen into disrepair.

People live here out of necessity. A life inside the walls beats one without.

Nobody here is going to volunteer anything. You will have to choose how you work it.

Three ways to do this, and the day is already half gone.

nextObjectiveId.text: Find an old contact from your Chunin days.
Wait until dusk and watch for movement.

objectives.description:
You ask. People stop talking when you get close and start again when you pass.

One man points you at a doss house. The doss house points you at a scrap yard. The scrap yard points you back at the doss house.
You spend the afternoon walking in a circle somebody drew for you.

By dusk you have four addresses. Three are empty. The fourth is a woman who has never heard the name, and who flinched when she heard it anyway.

Not at you. At the name.

Whoever he came to meet, he met them on this street, and he is already done.

nextObjectiveId.text: The east gate. Cut him off before he leaves.

objectives.description:
You reach the east verge as he is walking out of it. He stops, looks at how hard you are breathing, and seems almost sorry for you.

"You have been at this all day."

"I was done by noon."
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description:
He is over the verge and into the treeline, and you have nothing but a day of walking.

Somewhere behind you a doss house is pointing somebody at a scrap yard.
You still know people from before you made rank. One of them runs a back room off the tannery row and owes you nothing, which is why he will talk.

The room is small and he keeps his voice down the whole time.

"Old Ghost. Yes. Warehouse off the cut, tonight."

He gives you a door and does not ask why you want it.

The door is unlocked, the warehouse is empty, and two come off the rafters the moment you are three steps in.

This was never his location.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description:
The rafters were a good place to wait and they had been waiting a while.

You come to on an empty floor with two hours gone and a door standing open.

Two down in an empty building. Nobody here has been in the same district as Old Ghost tonight.

A setup. Not by your contact, who was told the same thing you were, but by whoever fed it to him.

Somebody wanted you in an empty warehouse for two hours.

nextObjectiveId.text: So where were they not sending me?

objectives.description: You go back to what you were told and work out what it was built to keep you away from. The cut runs north to the old dye works and the dye works have a night watchman nobody has paid in a month.

The dye works. Two hours late, but not too late.

There are lights on in a building that has no reason to have lights, and three sets of prints in the yard mud.

Two of them are not his.
He does not look surprised to see you. The other two move to put you between them, and he lets them, and only then does he step forward himself.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description:
Three of them in a yard, and the two were only ever there to hold you still.

By the time you are up the dye works are dark and the lights are off in a building that had no reason to have them.
You find a roofline with a view of the whole eastern quarter and you wait for the light to go.
Two hours after dusk, three figures leave a house at the bottom of the slope and move up the lane without lamps.

They are good. Spaced, quiet, and taking the route with the fewest windows on it. You follow anyway.

At the third corner the lead figure stops without turning around.

They know.
The two at the back turn to meet you and the third does not. He is already moving, and he does not look back once.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description:
Two of them in a narrow lane is a poor place to be, and the third is gone regardless.

The house at the bottom of the slope is empty by the time you get down to it.

Two down in the lane, and a long way up the slope somebody is still running.

He has not looked back once, which means he knew the other two were staying the moment he decided to leave them.
You go after him. Over the slope, across four roofs, down into the drainage cut and out the other side.

He runs out of village before he runs out of breath.

The cut ends at the wall and he turns to face you, and he is not even breathing hard.

"You are the fifth," he says. "Or the sixth. I have stopped counting properly."
No escort, no rafters, and nowhere left to be. He rolls his shoulder once and waits for you to come to him.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description:
He has been getting out of places like this since before you were born.

When you look up, the foot of the wall is empty and there is nothing to say he was ever standing at it.

He is down at the verge with his business already concluded and nothing on him to show what it was.

He was finished by noon. You spent the day walking, and he let you.

You file it that night. Old Ghost. Bounty contract. Taken inside the village.

She reads it. Then reads it again.

"...Did you?"

"I believe your report. I have believed four of them."

She signs it and does not close the contract.

"He was ANBU here once. I was on the road the first time somebody confirmed him dead. Take the pay and do not think about it too hard."

nextObjectiveId.text: Ask how she was so sure it was him.

objectives.description:
The pen moves. She does not look up while it does, and the contract is still open when she sets it down.

When you are at the door she says it to your back.

"Many have reported the same. Myself included."

"Because he taught me how to be sure."

She does not look up from the page.

"That is all you get. The contract stays open. It always does."

The pay is A rank and it clears the same day.

The contract stays open.
Report filed. Contract open.
The slums, and three ways to work it.
The board, and four places to look.

Three down in a dye works yard, and the lights still on in a building with no reason to have them.

He waited for the other two to commit before he moved once, which is how he has stayed on that contract as long as he has.

You file it that night. Old Ghost. Bounty contract. Taken inside the village.

Alone at the foot of the wall, with the two he left behind still in a lane on the other side of the slope.

He ran out of village before he ran out of breath, and he never once looked back at them.

You file it that night. Old Ghost. Bounty contract. Taken inside the village.
